en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street in a historic European town, lined with two‑ and three‑story stucco or stone houses with steep tiled roofs. People in early 20th‑century clothing (men in suits, women in long dresses and aprons, children in caps and coats) stand and walk along the street. In the distance a tall church or town‑hall tower with a spire dominates the skyline. Hanging signs identify a restaurant and café on the right side.
